It preserves inclusion, nonempty intersection, non-strict |.| comparisons and strict |.| comparisons, so every nonempty spectrum is closed under addition. Any nonempty additive semigroup S⊆N+ has a least a and finitely many least occupied residue representatives modulo a; every s∈S is its residue representative plus q a, proving finite generation. For generators g_i, select sum g_i Boolean atoms (enough noun variables), block them into sizes g_i, force every unused atom empty by inclusion A⊆complement(A), and equate cardinalities within each block by mutual >= sentences. Their positive total model sizes are exactly all nonzero combinations sum g_i t_i with t_i≥0, and every such combination is realized. A contradictory theory gives empty spectrum. The finite examples 4a+7b were checked independently but are illustrative; the all-semigroup statement follows from the abstract proof and positive-universe boundary.
